description: Machine catalog for buying an HBMeasure report: auth, min price ($1.34 by card (covers the card processing fee)), POST checkout URL, Stripe payment methods, terms of sale, skill and JSON discovery links. Read-only; does not create a Checkout Session. Terms of sale: All sales are final. Each report is computed for your address when you order, so we cannot offer refunds once an order is placed. If we cannot produce a report for your address, the order is recorded and our staff will follow up with you; we may re-run it or issue a replacement report. Measurements are estimates graded Verified / Measured / Estimated; check them before ordering materials or relying on them for a claim or contract. The catalog also lists the x402 products: x402 (USDC on Base): $1.00 report, $0.05 coverage check, $0.25 building code lookup.
